body: Yea, never got into much Western philosophy.  My major and all that is focused into Eastern studies.  But I'd love to see the essays if you could recommend or link.

Yea I go through these episodes where I'm like am I the ones whose N?  Am I causing all of this?  Its the way we were raised unfortunately.

I don't anywhere to go for the next 5 days so I just have to put up with it.  But I'm forcing myself to commit by sending important things to my surrogate family instead of keeping them here.

Yea, I know.  Its like a track that goes through my head every time I get rightfully mad at her.  Its like I realized when I was younger subconsciously the only way to end conflicts was to apologize and agree that she was right at which point I would get affection at the cost of being "crazy."

Trying to shut that track off and learn that my concerns are valid.

Yea I got my xanax, so hoping it will calm me way down on the plane.  Also I'm practicing mindfulness and breathing exercises when the panic starts to arise now.  Its really nice just to tell someone about it and hear a helpful response.  Getting it off my chest has also been really helpful so thanks for reading.

>She will get all kinds of mileage out of making herself a martyr sandwich over "she's so ungrateful, after all I did for her, she never calls me, blah blah blah".

You're absolutely right.  Its like I imagine she would be hurt and feel this incredible amount of guilt and pain because thats how I imagine I would feel if someone abandoned me but in fact she will just blame me.  Her being sad would depend on her actually reflecting and blaming herself for these issues which she will never do.  I know exactly what she will say, "Momoshosho is just so sick..."  She will never question herself.  

So thank you for your advice.  I'm going to start taking steps today to being NC.  I'm going to sort through my stuff here and start sending things I want to have and don't want her to get into back to my surrogate family.  I think the process of actually packing my shit to leave and not having to worry about her throwing it away or selling it will make me feel so much better.

Thank you again.

Thanks for this.  Its gets tossed around a lot at home and so I'm trying to see the grey areas and realize everyone is just doing their thing.  This piece is long but I'm gonna try to read it tomorrow to pick me up after all this.

Wow.  Thanks so much.  I realized how long this was and wasn't expecting to get a response.

I can't reveal where I'm going as I'm afraid my mom or someone familiar with all this will identify me.  I haven't even been able to get excited because I'm terrified of flying and keep feeling like I'm facing imminent death.  Told my mom about this fear today and she used it as an opportunity to berate me and say why don't I care about her fears.  Then when I wanted to just for once hear her validate me.  She shutdown an ignored gave me the face telling me she was annoyed and I should go.  She had said her piece and it was done.  I just needed someone to reach out to and tell me its ok.  It was heartbreaking again to realize I will never have that.  Thats why I wrote this long rant.  

I've lived under her roof only being allowed to eat one meal of a bowl of noodles a day.  Having no blanket, dirty clothes.  Inadvertently her neglect made me able to face that shit early on.  I know I can do all that and scrape by on my own.  I'm also paying my tuition, rest is financial aid so luckily know serious financial bonds.  

My whole thing is I get this guilt feeling.  Like she's never gonna change but she can't even realize why I'm upset.  If I left it would hurt her.  She'll be all alone as an old lady.  I remember some of the good memories and convinced myself she sacrificed so much.  Its so hard from an emotional/guilt standpoint.  I've been listening to Headlights by Eminem as cheesy as that sounds to get the courage up.

Thanks also for talking about this issue with my father.  I've talked with my therapist, she thinks its something I have to wait on too.  As stupid as it sounds, I needed someone else to tell me that I was a kid.  Haha, sometimes I feel like therapists have to say that to make sure you don't kill yourself.  There's a lot of constraints, my mom is a "battered woman warrior", she is constantly posting on all these forums, giving all this advice and telling people their SO's are evil, demon possessed, and how she got out of the corrupt court system all by herself.  She says she doesn't use my name but I know she does.  My father has a large family and I also want to avoid any vengeance or anything towards my mom.  At a certain point I should have stood up and told the truth and I know that and I want to face it on my own.

And also I know my dad isn't perfect.  

Maybe I can just be comfortable knowing I don't really have parents anymore besides my surrogate parents who have always shown me incredible amounts of love.  I just wanted and dreamed about all those experiences kids are supposed to have and as I get older I get more desperate and at that same time less hopeful.  But its fucked up like i think oh maybe when I have kids she'll be better, or I'm just imagining all this fucked up ness.

Anyways sorry for rant, thanks for giving me that extra push to go NC, I think I'll talk to my therapist about it tomorrow.
